answer_2.quote: BAD-X gains on average 1.06% in accuracy and 0.66% in F 1 compared to MAD-X on POS task. It outscores the multilingual adapter on POS even more: 3.55% in accuracy and 2.87% in F1 on average. The gains over MAD-X are even more pronounced on the more complex DP task: BAD-X outperforms MAD-X on average with a gap of 2.62% in UAS and 2.38% in LAS scores.
